questions: Previous positive fixture verifies search consumed; actual LLM writing/quality needs credentials

questions: Inspected A4 explicitly NOT_USED. TS resolved references, construction/export and route registry inspected; callback/plugin/config/cross-process global exclusion incomplete => UNRESOLVED. Do not say entire Profile UNUSED

reviewedImportantStates.name: Static capability descriptions/request
producers: Host plugin grants + read-text registrations; model REQUEST_CAPABILITY
consumers: Runtime admission and host executable dispatch
questions: Default server discovery/grants empty; arbitrary builtin tools are not automatically available

consumers: createServerMcpReadTextObservation
questions: 64k read result not durable learned experience; normalize limit can remove all body

reviewedImportantStates.name: CognitionCapabilityObservation
consumers: Next Reasoning input pair
questions: 16k-char overflow status hides successful read and cause

reviewedImportantStates.name: Intent/attempt/outcome and transient effect result
consumers: Claim/cancel/reconcile workers and operation freshness; adapter caller
questions: APPLIED is contract-layer completion, not proof model understood; volatile grants not restored after reboot

reviewedImportantStates.name: Runtime events
consumers: Runtime/display/presentation/dashboard wildcard subscribers
questions: Subscriber resolution can be dynamic; EventBus catches errors; publication receipt is not transaction over subscribers

reviewedImportantStates.name: Recent diagnostic events
consumers: HTTP events/debug and WS dashboard
questions: Intentional bounded diagnostics; NOT USED by model is not automatically a waste

reviewedImportantStates.name: Reply target/frame/publish status
consumers: Transport clients; terminal reply/persistence/reconcile policy
questions: Transport delivery is not reader comprehension; full DB failure/restart requires deployed probe

reviewedImportantStates.name: Synthesis metadata receipt
consumers: Media effect causal authority; Journal
questions: Raw text deliberately NOT_RETAINED, no expected semantic consumer for raw receipt text

reviewedImportantStates.name: Audio/speech segment seals/playback acknowledgments
producers: Media effect service; provider audio; client reports
consumers: Publication/playback gate and client
questions: Acknowledged playback not thought/learning; all client state transitions pending

reviewedImportantStates.name: STT whole text + timed per-speaker segment text
consumers: LocalSTT provider; finalized speech reservation; review; transcript context
questions: Actual sidecar preserves span words; downstream transcript-only input may lose cluster distinctions

reviewedImportantStates.name: Acoustic template/match/binding evidence

consumers: Speech attribution/review; product binding governed commands
questions: Never equate acoustic match to Person trust; full native transaction/reconcile untested

reviewedImportantStates.name: PID/ownership/health/leases
consumers: UI diagnostics; restart/stop/capture lease logic
questions: Platform execution not performed; no automatic individual intelligence claim

reviewedImportantStates.name: Runtime/product settings and secrets
producers: Native config commands; server settings APIs
consumers: env_export; ProviderRegistry/context boot; management UI
questions: Configured features can still lack model entry; private deployed settings unknown

reviewedImportantStates.name: Recent episodes/Dream jobs
consumers: runDue in post-turn path; writer only if configured
questions: No complete dynamic proof of all timer hosts; default inspected call lacks idleMs; global NO worker claim not upgraded

questions: Default-session context issue reused; consent policy is necessary; exhaustive suspend/resume not closed

consumers: Current turn multimodal evidence and outward perception event
questions: Raw media not retained; repeated observation tools not universally wired; real-device/provider quality open
